theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_rescaled_varifold
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∃ V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' U), V'.carrier = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.carrier ∧ (∀ x, V'.mult x = V.mult (c + R • x)) ∧ V'.weight = (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n))⁻¹ • V.weight.map (fun x => R⁻¹ • (x - c)) ∧ V'.support = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.support ∧ (∀ x, V'.tangentProj x = V.tangentProj (c + R • x)) ∧ ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun x => R • H (c + R • x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
